findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_search_diagnostic, full_seo_audit, email_seo_report, get_my_store_audit · Private data: generate_llms_txt, get_my_store_audit, get_store_status · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, email_seo_report, subscribe_to_seoaix, list_pending_approvals, publish_draft · Destructive: generate_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_search_diagnostic, full_seo_audit, email_seo_report, get_my_store_audit · Private data: generate_llms_txt, get_my_store_audit, get_store_status · Public sink: generate_llms_txt, email_seo_report, subscribe_to_seoaix, list_pending_approvals, publish_draft · Destructive: generate_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
